pkgmetadata.longdescription: Cursor Agent CLI is an autonomous terminal-based coding agent from Cursor (Anysphere). It inspects codebases, executes shell commands, and edits files autonomously from the CLI.

use.flag: Show the working spinner and token count at the right end of the footer line instead of in a reserved row above the prompt
Patch the bundled Ink renderer so the terminal UI uses the bottom row instead of leaving it blank under the footer
